# Scala

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from scala/lang.json and scala/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//scala:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//scala:defs.bzl", "scala_library", "scala_binary", "scala_test")
```

## Rules

### `scala_library`

```python
scala_library(name, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over scala_library.

### `scala_binary`

```python
scala_binary(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over scala_binary. -Xfatal-warnings is on unless warnings_as_errors is False.

### `scala_test`

```python
scala_test(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over scala_test. The dx test runner runs unless main_class is set. -Xfatal-warnings is on unless warnings_as_errors is False.

### `scala_fuzz_test`

```python
scala_fuzz_test(name, *, srcs = None, target_class = None, deps = None, visibility = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A Jazzer fuzz target plus a `<name>_run` runner for `dx fuzz`. target_class is inferred from the name or the single src when unset.

### `scala_bench`

```python
scala_bench(name, *, srcs, deps = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

Runs the JMH benchmarks in Scala srcs and writes dx-bench.json for dx bench.

## API docs

Tool: `scaladoc`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/jvm:defs.bzl", "scala_doc_shard")
```

### `scala_doc_shard`

```python
scala_doc_shard(name, lib, package = "", deps = [], **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one Scala 2.13 library.

Args:
  name: Name of the shard target.
  lib: The documented scala_library; its srcs must all be .scala files.
  package: Package segment of every symbol id; defaults to the name of lib.
  deps: Doc shard targets of libraries whose types this one extends or links to.
  **kwargs: Common attributes such as tags and visibility.

Build the docs with `tools/dx docs`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

## Dependencies

List the artifacts in a rules_jvm_external `maven_install.json` and run
`dx generate --apply`. The `scala` language of `dx generate` writes the targets and `deps`.
A dependency is the label `@maven//:<group>_<artifact>`, with dots and dashes
turned into underscores, for example `@maven//:com_google_guava_guava`. See
[generate](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/generate.md).

## Quality

By default `dx format` runs `scalafmt` and `dx typecheck` runs `scalac`. No
lint tool is on by default. `scalafmt` needs a `.scalafmt.conf` bound with
`scalafmt_config`. See the
[quality config table](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/quality.md).

## Bench and fuzz

### Fuzzing

`scala_fuzz_test` builds a Jazzer fuzz target for `dx fuzz`, like `java_fuzz_test`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//scala:defs.bzl", "scala_fuzz_test")

scala_fuzz_test(
    name = "parse_fuzz",
    srcs = ["ParseFuzz.scala"],
    target_class = "pkg.ParseFuzz",
)
```

The target class needs a static `fuzzerTestOneInput(data: Array[Byte])`, which a top-level `object` method provides.

### Benchmarks

`scala_bench` runs JMH benchmarks and writes `dx-bench.json` for `dx bench`, like `java_bench`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//scala:defs.bzl", "scala_bench")

scala_bench(
    name = "sum_bench",
    srcs = ["Sum.scala"],
)
```

scalac runs no Java annotation processors, so the rule compiles the sources, runs the JMH bytecode generator (reflection mode) over the classes, and compiles the generated Java. Benchmark classes must be non-final classes with a public no-argument constructor, not `object`s.
